# RT — Runtime and composition

- Owner: `ticonnect-runtime`
- Stage: 2
- Layer: `daemon`
- Component graph: [generated/components/rt.md](generated/components/rt.md)

## Purpose

Own process lifecycle, composition root, signals, shutdown, single-instance guard, and autostart wiring for every binary.

## Boundary

Depends on settings, logging, and daemon service wiring. Does not own domain state, network state, or UI state.

## Owned state

- process lifecycle
- shutdown signal

## Invariants

- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- exit non-zero on startup failure
- release bus name on shutdown
- never run as root
